title: Non-root Node container
description:
Write a Dockerfile based on node:22-alpine, with WORKDIR /app, copy package manifests, run npm ci --omit=dev, copy source, switch to USER node, and start node server.js. Dependency installation must precede copying all source.

STATIC LAB: YAML is parsed and listed fields are checked. Docker/HCL/shell are bounded authored text checks, not real tools. Passing is not a deployability or security guarantee.

reference.text:
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

hints: What must exist before the next operation can work?
Which field links this resource to the thing it controls?
What observation would prove readiness rather than just existence?
editorial: Copying manifests first lets dependency layers survive source-only changes. A non-root user reduces privilege but does not alone make a container secure.
